representation: p1_ac residual then frozen positive affine; exact declared interpretation
diagnostic_timing_scope: packed stack/copy/unpack plus coordinate-finite flag at the original decision point; included in optimize_seconds but after existing forward clock; no additional per-trial timers

512.stencil: central interior; first-order one-sided at both endpoints; hx=hy=1/side
512.edge_rule: max(side/255, .1 fixed-mask mean gradient norm), independently per frozen input
512.moving_calibration: original moving intensity sampled ONCE through initial affine; frozen thereafter
512.derivative: differentiate spatial gradient of freshly warped intensity; no moving-gradient transport or detach
512.flat_region_caution: flat moving intensity has zero NGF image gradient, even against a fixed edge
512.identity_caution: finite epsilon need not give zero identical-image loss or stationary map gradient

image_objective_scope: stage raster continuation; final full-resolution selection
selected_stage_scope: None=initial identity residual, -1=accepted capture prefix, nonnegative=ordinary stage index

image_match_evidence.path_check: raster basenames plus side and sampling-affine values; relocated paths allowed, not content identity proof
image_match_evidence.mask: fixed target coordinate inside original moving rectangle; no adaptive query dropping

image_preprocessing.name: raw_inverted
image_preprocessing.moving_data_term: FAIR-style NGF of original intensity warped ONCE through complete map
image_preprocessing.moving_gradient_frame: fixed image frame after intensity warp

acceptance_objective: original complete objective at current image resolution; full-resolution trajectory may not be monotone
oob: zero padding, fixed denominator, explicit quadratic excess penalty; no query dropping
